cohort: 100 pregnant women undergoing either lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) or normal delivery were placed in a control group (n=50 LSCS, n=50 normal delivery) and 100 pregnant women undergoing either LSCS or normal delivery were placed in a treatment group (n=50 LSCS, n=50 normal delivery).
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly reduced blood loss from placental delivery to 2 hours postpartum in both LSCS and normal delivery.
